Digital Table Clock with Wireless Charger | A140

Upgrade your workspace with the Digital Table Clock with Wireless Charger | A140, a perfect blend of modern design, smart functionality, and everyday convenience. This digital clock with 10W wireless phone charger is designed for users who want a clutter-free desk while keeping their devices powered throughout the day. Whether placed on an office desk, bedside table, or study area, this clock delivers reliable timekeeping and fast wireless charging in one compact unit.

Featuring a built-in wireless charger up to 10W, this digital table clock supports Qi-compatible devices, allowing you to charge your smartphone simply by placing it on the clock surface. No extra cables, no tangled wires—just effortless charging combined with a clear digital display.

Clear Digital Display with Backlight

The backlight for easy visibility in low light ensures that the time is always readable, whether you’re working late hours or checking the clock at night. The crisp LED display provides excellent clarity without straining your eyes, making this digital wireless charging clock ideal for both professional and personal use.

10W Wireless Charging for Qi-Compatible Devices

This digital clock with wireless charger offers fast and stable charging with up to 10W wireless output. It is compatible with most Qi-enabled smartphones, including popular Android and iOS models. The Type C input for wireless charging ensures efficient power delivery and improved charging performance compared to older micro-USB designs.

Whether you are using it as a desk clock with phone charger or a bedside wireless charging clock, the A140 model provides consistent performance and dependable charging every day.

Practical and Stylish Design

Designed with a practical and stylish design, this digital table clock complements modern interiors effortlessly. Its compact form factor saves space while adding a sleek, professional look to your desk. The minimalist design makes it a reliable and practical addition to any workspace, home office, or bedside setup.

The sturdy construction ensures durability, while the balanced weight keeps the clock stable during phone placement and removal. This makes it a dependable choice for users looking for a wireless charging digital alarm clock that looks as good as it performs.

Battery Operated with Type C Power Support

The clock function operates on 2 x AAA batteries (not included), ensuring uninterrupted time display even during power outages. For wireless charging functionality, the device uses a Type C input, offering flexibility and compatibility with modern adapters and power banks. This dual-power design makes the ideal for daily use at home, offices, hotels, and corporate environments.

Key Features

  • Digital table clock with built-in wireless charger up to 10W
  • Qi-compatible wireless charging for supported smartphones
  • Clear digital display with backlight for low-light visibility
  • Modern, practical, and stylish design
  • Reliable and practical addition to any workspace or bedside table
  • Works on 2 x AAA batteries (not included) for clock operation
  • Type C input for efficient wireless charging
  • Ideal as a desk clock, bedside clock, or office table clock

Why Choose?

If you are searching for a that combines convenience, efficiency, and modern aesthetics, the A140 model is an excellent choice. It reduces cable clutter, enhances desk organization, and ensures your phone stays charged while keeping accurate time. Perfect for professionals, students, and tech-savvy users, this delivers everyday reliability with a clean and contemporary look—making it a smart investment for any modern workspace or bedroom.
